story.headline: The "proven strategies" weren't written for us.
story.para1: When I first tried to build businesses in Haiti, I failed over and over.
story.para2: I even failed my dad's small business.
story.para3: Not because we were lazy. We worked hard. We stayed up late. We did what the books and YouTube videos said. But almost every "proven" strategy I found was built for North America or Europe.

breakpoint.title: And that's where it broke.
breakpoint.para1: Those models assumed things I didn't have: stable infrastructure, easy access to bank accounts and cards, marketing budgets, and customers who behave like they do in the U.S. or Europe. None of that matched my Haitian reality.
breakpoint.para2: So every time I followed the "right steps"… I still got the wrong results.

story.global: What happened to me in Haiti is happening right now across Africa, Latin America, and the Caribbean. People are losing jobs to AI and automation, and they're turning to small businesses and side hustles to survive. But they're handed the same foreign playbooks and expensive tools… and then we're surprised when most of those businesses fail.

cycle.intro: If nothing changes, this cycle keeps repeating:

whyExists.label: Why BizSproutAI exists
whyExists.title: BizSproutAI is built for founders in places like ours.
whyExists.para1: It teaches you how your market really works—how people buy, how they pay, what channels they actually use—then helps you validate your idea with the right framework for your business type (ecommerce, coaching, consulting, tech, finance, and more).
whyExists.para2: Then you follow a step-by-step Launch Sprint to get your first paying customers. No degree. No coding. No more guessing with someone else's playbook.
